note: GT = CALLOUT-CLASS machined dims (distinct G1/G2/G3 FEED-move feature diameters + overall feed-Z length, inch→mm) — NOT every toolpath vertex (a roughing pass has ~100+ points a print never dimensions; using those as the recall denominator would falsely fail even perfect OCR). recall = fraction of callout-class GT the OCR corroborated; precision = fraction of OCR dims that are real machined dims. PASS at recall>=0.5. GUARDS: only POSTED G-code text (binary .mcx-8/CAM sources skipped as program-not-nc); only LATHE axis (X=diameter; mill/unknown skipped as program-non-lathe). HONESTY: a low recall here = real-scan OCR reads few dims (a domain-shift weakness vs clean synthetic prints), NOT a metric artifact. Resumable: re-run continues from processed-cursor.jsonl.
